GROWTH HACKER - GLOBAL - $50/HR

Tech Job Finder is building an end-to-end platform for software engineers to get ready for all stages of interviewing. We recently raised a small seed round and now looking for a Growth Hacker to do B2C marketing for us. Think of it as a HackerRank challenger, packing many more features and all at a price of lunch.

Since launching earlier this year, we have helped more than 100 software engineers to get ready for their next DSA interview. We realise it isn't a lot, but we are already post pmf.

Ideally you have DevRel experience. Reach out with a resume, and a brief intro of how you'd approach scaling the reach of TechJobFinder to hiring@techjobfinder.com.

https://www.techjobfinder.com
